mapper.sql: select fua.id, fua.user_id, fua.balance, fua.use_balance, fua.create_time, fua.update_time, su.user_name, su.phonenumber, su.email, su.status, su.is_vip, su.vip_level, su.vip_begin_time, su.vip_expire_time from furniture_user_balance_account fua left join sys_user su on su.user_id = fua.user_id
mapper.select:
and su.user_name like concat('%', #{username}, '%')
order by fua.id desc
select fua.* from furniture_user_balance_account fua where fua.user_id = #{userId} order by fua.id desc limit 1
